_about: Changes of the public launch build (公測 1.0, 2026-11-26) against the third closed test, per character, read from the on-screen cards of one Bilibili video (read 2026-11-27). Restated as facts; the video's own wording is not kept. Rendered by pipeline/build_pages.py as the section 公測改動 of each character page, until launch-build game text replaces the test-build text.
